description: This file defines a React component named 'Column' which represents a column in a Kanban board application. It handles display, inline editing of the column title, deletion, and rendering of associated cards, with interactions and state management related to these functionalities.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new column title, ensuring it's not empty or unchanged.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing mode for the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new column title after validation, with error handling and success notifications.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles keyboard events in the title input field, triggering save on Enter and cancel on Escape.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the column and associated cleanup.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
